method: Read AGENTS.md, START-HERE.md, pilot-corrections.md and prior review24. Independently decoded all 168 frames of each supplied candidate, recomputed frame/seam and rigidity metrics, and verified SHA-256 before and after. Inspected native-source full scenes and source/motion/seam detail crops with view_image; smaller details enlarged 2x.
limitations: Sampled still-frame review, not continuous full-speed viewing or subjective sound audition.
Verdicts apply only to listed hashes and do not constitute integrated product or production-readiness approval.

scenes.scope: Exact-hash sampled visual inspection and full decode only; no continuous playback or audio audition.
findings: Original skyline, cathedral spires, bridge and window geometry remain crisp and stationary in sampled source/motion crops. The previous displaced skyline overlay is absent; the rain-filled exterior is intentionally static.
Only restrained steam above the cup changes. The sampled rim and background book edges remain stable, without obvious ghost outlines or mask boundaries. Seam endpoints show matching steam intensity.

All 168 frames decode. Independently measured seam-to-typical ratio is 0.3283, versus 4.2986 for the rejected original. Skyline temporal range is at most two RGB code values, consistent with codec variation.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed integrated playback and audition the selected ambience in the product.

scenes.scope: Exact-hash sampled visual inspection and full decode only; no continuous playback or audio audition.
findings: The sleeping cat retains the original crisp silhouette, paws and face in native detail crops. Its all-frame temporal range is one RGB code value; the sampled translucent alternate cat shape from the rejected original is absent.

Lantern and stove bars retain their original geometry. The stove treatment varies existing light with fixed flame shapes; this is restrained light modulation, not freely moving fire. Cup steam remains subtle and localized.
All 168 frames decode. Seam ratio is 0.5066. Source, motion and endpoint crops do not show a doubled lantern, displaced stove frame, or visible seam intensity jump.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed integrated playback and audition the selected ambience in the product.

scenes.scope: Exact-hash sampled visual inspection and full decode only; no continuous playback or audio audition.
findings: Both wall candles retain one crisp original flame and shaft. The sleeping cat also remains the original single silhouette. Left candle and cat inspected crops have zero all-frame temporal range; the right candle has at most one code value.

Generated fire now stays above the rigid fire screen. Both ornamental posts are visually unchanged and have zero all-frame temporal range. Screen bars and mesh remain crisp in source/motion/seam comparisons, with at most two code values of codec variation.

Upper flame shapes vary substantially but remain contained within the open hearth, without a second rigid post, shifted grate or obvious rectangular mask edge in sampled frames. The rest of the warm room stays still.
All 168 frames decode. Seam ratio is 1.0866. The last two and first two flame crops have coherent flame placement and brightness; continuous playback smoothness was not assessed.
followUps: Verify repeated full-speed integrated playback and audition the selected ambience in the product.
